verdict.headline: Supertubos Lunch
verdict.reason: Supertubos is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should help keep it tidy.  The tide is lining up for a powerful wedge, so keep the comfort level in mind.

conversationalSummary.text: Supertubos at Lunch looks like the best option, but it is still a check-first call. There is enough potential for a useful session, but the lack of push could spoil it. I'd check Surfline or MEO Beachcam before leaving.

best.explanation: Supertubos looks like a clean small window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.3-0.6 m, 40 kJ, 10 s period, lully 6/100, and good wind at 15 km/h.  A fast, hollow sand-bottom wave that gets serious quickly; this is best for short, punchy bodyboard barrels when it is small enough for comfort; 10-13s at mid tide is the prime barrel / wedge setup for Supertubos / Molhe Leste; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; spot surf looks too small.
